description: Update template config: theme, route overrides, settings, data sources, or the directory URL prefix. 🔴 `directory_base` is SAVED here but only goes LIVE on the next content_deploy_site — until then the site keeps serving the old prefix and template_get_config reports directory_base_pending=true. sitemap.xml follows the DEPLOYED prefix, so it never advertises a URL the site 404s.

directory_base.description: URL prefix for the built-in directory routes, e.g. 'ls' → /ls/plumbers/manchester/acme. Defaults to "directory". 422 if malformed (^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$), a reserved namespace (blog, docs, changelog, press, newsroom, f, lp, api), or colliding with a page slug or collection route_base. NOT LIVE until content_deploy_site runs.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: template_update_config
